issue.title: Bank UI e2e chip-today fails: FIXTURE_TODAY is hard-coded to 2026-11-12, so the daily chip omits waiting
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-lc.7 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-lc land agent.

## What fails

`scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs` (bob-plugins, real Obsidian under xvfb) records
`chip-today` as FAIL with reason `today chip missing waiting`. bob-cli-lc.7 saw it red on
2026-11-13 on a tree where it was already red before that phase's changes; the Category
card work never touched the daily chip (`241n-plugin-bank-daily-chip.js`) or its model.

## Root cause (read from source, bob-plugins master b2a77a7)

- `scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e-lib.cjs:9` hard-codes `const FIXTURE_TODAY = "2026-11-12";`
  and the e2e opens that day's daily note, then asserts the chip text contains `waiting`
  (`assertChip(..., { waiting: true })`, lib line ~854).
- `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/241l-plugin-bank-cards-model.js:289` sets
  `waitingAll` only when `date === today` (the plugin's clock date). On any real date after
  2026-11-12 the fixture "today" is a past day, so `waitingAll` is `null` and the chip
  (`241n-plugin-bank-daily-chip.js:209`) omits the `· N waiting` suffix.

So the assertion is a time bomb that went red the day after the fixture was written.

## Fix direction

Derive the fixture's today from the clock the plugin uses (or pin the plugin's clock in
the e2e the way other real-Obsidian e2e scripts pin time), keep the historical-day chip
assertion (`waiting: false`) on a genuinely past day, and rerun the full bank UI e2e.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the e2e asserts waiting on a hard-coded 2026-11-12 'today' while the model only reports waiting when the note date equals the clock date, so it fails on every date after 2026-11-12.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-lc.7 proposed it as a pre-existing real-Obsidian e2e failure; the land agent traced it to a hard-coded fixture date, so it is a true, deterministic failure unrelated to the Category card epic.

evidence.note: Independent repro: scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs still fails only chip-today after Category-card landing-fixes; walk-card-layout, walk-learn-coffee, and walk-learn-accept pass.
